name: Tyria Chronicle 0.2.22-beta
body:
# Tyria Chronicle 0.2.22-beta

Windows x64; requires Raidcore Nexus. By ZevaXO.

## Important upgrade note

Updating with GW2 closed remains the conservative option. Follow-up analysis of the previous multi-addon live-update crash found the initial access violation in another addon; this does not establish that every hot-update scenario is safe.

**If you use 0.2.15 or 0.2.16, close GW2 and install the ZIP manually.** Those versions can crash while unloading during a live update. New code cannot protect the old DLL while it is being unloaded. Replace only TyriaChronicle.dll; keep your settings folder.

## What's new

- Add separate editable templates for the Jormag, Primordus, Zhaitan, Mordremoth, Kralkatorrik and Soo-Won Aurene weapon variants.
- Explain each timed stop's collection purpose and keep untimed map chains, crystals, vendor steps and required items/equipped weapons in goal tips. No invented countdowns or automatic achievement tracking.
- Rename the existing general template to Aurene weapon materials; existing saved lists and reminder choices are retained.

Open My lists > + New list > Use a template. Select a variant and create your editable copy. Rewards & purpose explains each stop; More tips for this goal covers untimed steps. Creating a list does not enable reminders or detect your achievement stage. These are timer aids, not full crafting checklists.

## Fishing

Open Fishing next to the clock, choose your map region, then enable Fishing reminders if wanted. Main Notifications must be on and Mute off. Dawn and Dusk last five minutes; day/night fish can also be caught during those transitions. This clock follows the standard outdoor schedule, not live map detection: fixed-time maps and instances can differ.

## Download and update

Use Nexus's Check for Updates with pre-release updates enabled for Tyria Chronicle. In 0.2.8-beta or newer, Update options > Open Nexus addons provides a shortcut to the host addon list; complete the update in Nexus. The old direct Update button in 0.2.6/0.2.7 is not supported.

For manual installation, download **TyriaChronicle-0.2.22-beta-windows-x64.zip**, close GW2 and replace **Guild Wars 2/addons/TyriaChronicle.dll** with the file from the ZIP. Settings and lists are retained. The SHA256 file verifies the ZIP. GitHub's Source code downloads are not the installable addon; the standalone DLL asset is for Nexus updates. Version information may take a few minutes to propagate.

## Support and feedback

Use Help & feedback or [Discord](https://discord.gg/3gf8n2P9KS). GitHub bug reports are optional. For fishing times, include your map, selected region, local/UTC setting and the observed phase.

## Testing and limitations

1594 core checks plus update-checker and UI/settings/DLL lifecycle tests passed locally. Individual reminder tests cover long/short/zero leads, reverting to default, notification ordering, duplicate suppression, muted/off and unselected events, shared Anomaly completion, fishing independence and persisted/legacy settings. Normal startup after the previous lifecycle fix was confirmed by the project owner. The owner confirmed the previous paired copy actions in-game and a successful isolated Tyria Chronicle live update to 0.2.20. Floating feedback and the new templates pass local rendering checks; the new templates have not yet been confirmed in-game. The harness covers duplicate/concurrent unload, late callbacks, recovery on reload, and queued update-check timing; it reproduces a failure with the previous release. This is not broad multi-system or exhaustive host-race validation. Tests cover later starts, midnight, overlap/buffer boundaries, per-list persistence, gap filtering and template IDs. Existing settings and lists are retained.

Schedules are estimates, not live map status. Planning durations are estimates, initially based on schedule windows. Map preparation, queues and population are not known. Suggestions are a curated shortlist, not live popularity data. Expired or unavailable chosen starts use the next future start. Plan choices affect Train preview and Share list; the main timeline and reminders still follow normal schedules. Sharing does not guarantee the route fits. Copy does not open game chat or send input. Paste manually into your chosen channel. Full-map and cutscene hiding is not separately implemented.

This is an AI-assisted development project, not an ArenaNet or Raidcore product. Applicable license notices are included in the ZIP.
